params.name: ply
params.comment: sheet thickness: every strip, each plug layer, and the joints' depth

params.name: finger
params.comment: the shortest cell along an edge

params.name: interf
params.comment: each plug's press-fit, over the bore across its flats

params.name: temp_c
params.comment: the air's temperature, warm from the breath, degrees C

params.name: c_mm_s
params.comment: speed of sound, mm/s

params.name: a4
params.comment: concert pitch, Hz

params.name: end
params.comment: the open end's correction, times the bore's equivalent radius

params.name: area_low
params.comment: the lowest tube's bore area, mm²

params.name: area_high
params.comment: the highest tube's, mm²; those between step evenly

params.name: spare
params.comment: empty tube below each plug, so it can come down and flatten the note

params.name: cell_1
